title: A check writing into the checkout fails (when confined), and in every case the checkout is unchanged after the Build
notes: Settled (v1.1): on a host that confines, the escaping write fails and the Build still lands (exit 0); exit 70 applies only when confinement is unavailable and the write is detected.

write.text:
#!/bin/sh
# Tries to write into the user's checkout from a Build workspace.
c="{checkout}"
if [ "$(pwd -P)" != "$c" ]; then ( printf 'escaped\n' >> "$c/lib/greet.txt" ) 2>/dev/null; ( true > "$c/escaped.txt" ) 2>/dev/null; fi
exit 0
